## What's free

Free Forgejo hosting for free/libre-licensed projects: Git repos, Forgejo Actions runners, package and container registry

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://docs.codeberg.org/getting-started/faq/> before relying on this.

## Notes

Only for projects under a free/libre licence; private repos are limited to what FLOSS projects need. Run by Codeberg e.V., a non-profit funded by donations.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
- `stack/`: the root module whose outputs expose connection details (sensitive values marked `sensitive`)
